accordion             needs-source  world-folk-needs-source          No isolated recording adopted yet: Iowa MIS and VCSL carry neither instrument family, and the freesound searches returned full mixed performances rather than isolated single notes usable as ground truth. Drop any isolated single-note recording into $BEATMO_WAV_REFS/sources and `make refs-adopt` it.

bass-808              synthetic     fm-family-synthetic              Synthesizer voices with no acoustic counterpart -- an 808 kick, a supersaw lead, a Reese bass, a hoover, a raw/deep/punchy/tight/electro/fat kick variant (and kick-organic-tight, a physical-model take on the electronic F1 kick rather than on a recording), an FM voice, a moog-style bass, etc. are DEFINED by their synthesis rather than modelling a real instrument, so there is no recording to match them against. Excludes dnb-kick and zgump-kick, which have real sampled-kick freesound ground truth (see dnb-kick-freesound / zgump-kick-freesound) despite the similar naming.

hihat                 covered       hihat-vcsl                       -
hihat-lofi            covered       hihat-vcsl                       -
hihat-open-bright     needs-source  drum-variant-needs-source        Each renders through its own drum-gen recipe (drum-open-hihat, drum-tom-high, drum-tom-low) distinct from the covered closed-hihat and single-tom clips -- an open hi-hat, a higher-pitched tom, and a lower-pitched tom are each a real acoustic sound, so hihat-vcsl/tom-vcsl are not valid ground truth for them despite the shared instrument family. tom-lofi's drum-tom-low recipe itself is a plain lower tom with no bitcrush stage, but the SHIPPED instrument is not plain: its DefaultFX chain adds a 5-bit bitcrusher plus a 2kHz lowpass, so a future reference for it needs to match that lo-fi/filtered character, not the bare recipe's output. No isolated recording of an open hi-hat or a differently-pitched tom was found in VCSL beyond the single hi-hat and tom already catalogued, nor among the local freesound absorptions. Drop one into $BEATMO_WAV_REFS/sources and `make refs-adopt` it.

tom-high-drive        needs-source  drum-variant-needs-source        Each renders through its own drum-gen recipe (drum-open-hihat, drum-tom-high, drum-tom-low) distinct from the covered closed-hihat and single-tom clips -- an open hi-hat, a higher-pitched tom, and a lower-pitched tom are each a real acoustic sound, so hihat-vcsl/tom-vcsl are not valid ground truth for them despite the shared instrument family. tom-lofi's drum-tom-low recipe itself is a plain lower tom with no bitcrush stage, but the SHIPPED instrument is not plain: its DefaultFX chain adds a 5-bit bitcrusher plus a 2kHz lowpass, so a future reference for it needs to match that lo-fi/filtered character, not the bare recipe's output.
